column44: Blue cells are the ones you type in; the two totals tables fill themselves in.
After each game: add a row to GAMES, one row per skater who got a goal/assist/penalty in GAME LOG - SKATERS, and one row per goalie in GAME LOG - GOALIES.
PIM: league minors are 1:30, so each minor = 1.5 PIM.
GP counts every game for every skater. If a kid misses a game, type his real GP number over the formula in the GP column.
SV% shows blank until a goalie has saves recorded (no saves box on WNYAHL scoresheets).
Skater totals are listed by points through 8/30. To re-sort later: select the 13 player rows and use Data > Sort range > by column F (Z to A).
